answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit escrow bond and files a fable, a signed job record. A bridge links it to two standing referrers across a trellis graph, who must countersign the fable; a false or shared fable burns all three bonds. The first filing costs 30, the thousandth still 30, so 1,000 fakes cost 100,000, each needing two fresh referrers. An honest agent pays 70 once. A rented-fable ring fails since one referrer cannot vouch for two fakes.
